newsitem.title: USA: Central and South West to form alliance.
newsitem.headline: Central and South West to form alliance.

text.p: Central and South West Corp and Itron Inc have agreed to form a marketing alliance to promote utility management solutions, the companies said Wednesday.

Through Central and South West's Customer Choice & Control program, the companies will provide utilities, cities, cooperatives and other entities with communications-based utility management services, they said.
Itron's Genesis fixed-network system will be used as part of the Customer Choice & Control system that Central and South West is installing for Georgetown, Texas, the companies said.
Itron will become Central and South West's wireless network and meter-communications provider of choice for energy management pilot projects, the companies said.
The two companies said they will work to develop new marketing opportunities.
